title: Attribute
wikitext:
[[File:Attributes.png|thumb|A character's attributes]]
The three core '''attributes''' are [[Strength]], [[Dexterity]], and [[Intelligence]]. Most [[equipment]], [[skill gem]]s, and [[support gem]]s have attribute requirements. A character must meet or exceed an item's attribute requirements in order to use it.

Each attribute also provides certain inherent bonuses:

:Every 10 '''[[Strength]]''' grants
:* An additional 5 maximum [[life]]
:* 2% increased melee [[physical damage]]

:Every 10 '''[[Dexterity]]''' grants
:* An additional 20 [[accuracy]] rating
:* 2% increased [[evasion]] rating

:Every 10 '''[[Intelligence]]''' grants
:* An additional 5 maximum [[mana]]
:* 1% increased maximum [[energy shield]]

==Base Attributes==
{{see also|Strength#Base_Strength|Dexterity#Base_Dexterity|Intelligence#Base_Intelligence}}

All [[classes]] have a starting total of '''60''' attributes of different weights, based on their alignment on the [[passive]] tree. The [[Scion]], aligned with all three attributes, starts with 20 of each.

Note that on items, as the default minimum attributes of a character is 14, attribute requirements of 14 or below will be hidden unless the character's attributes are reduced below 14, such as through {{il|Actum}} or reflected jewellery.

==Modifying Attributes==
Attributes can be increased by stacking base [[Strength]], [[Dexterity]], [[Intelligence]], and/or {{c|magic|All Attributes}} and {{c|magic|X% increased Attributes}} modifiers.

===Implicit Attributes on Items===
One item has an [[Modifiers#Implicit_modifiers|implicit modifier]] that provides base {{c|magic|All Attributes}}:
{{Drop enabled base item table
|tables=item_stats
|join=items._pageID=item_stats._pageID
|where=item_stats.id LIKE "%additional_all_attributes%"
|level=1
|stat_column1_header=Attributes
|stat_column1_stat1_id=additional_all_attributes
}}

===Attributes on Equipment===
{{c|magic|All Attributes}} affixes can appear on the following base item categories. These modifiers are always suffixes.

* [[Amulets]] from {{c|magic|+1 to 32}}
* [[Rings]] from {{c|magic|+1 to 16}}
* [[Jewels]] from {{c|magic|+6 to 8}} ({{c|magic|of Adaption}})

The game has an {{c|mod|All Attributes}} crafting suffix mod that can be discovered in the lab [[Trial of Ascendancy|trial]] in [[The Tunnel]]. The mod {{c|mod|+(10 to 13) to all Attributes}} can be crafted onto the all items except [[flask]], [[belt]], [[jewel]], and [[map]].

===Unique Items with All Attributes Mods===
<section begin="additional_all_attributes" />
{{Drop enabled unique item table
|tables=item_stats
|join=items._pageID=item_stats._pageID
|where=item_stats.id LIKE "%additional_all_attributes%"
|level=1
|stat_column1_header=Attributes
|stat_column1_stat1_id=additional_all_attributes
}}<section end="additional_all_attributes" />

===Increasing or Decreasing Attributes===
A number of [[unique item|unique items]] provide percent (%) increases to Attributes. All base attributes from equipment and passives will be scaled by these modifiers.

====Increases to All Attributes====
<section begin="all_attributes_+%" />
{{Drop enabled unique item table
|tables=item_stats
|join=items._pageID=item_stats._pageID
|where=item_stats.id LIKE "%all_attributes_+\%%"
|level=1
|stat_column1_header=Attributes
|stat_column1_format=%s%%
|stat_column1_stat1_id=all_attributes_+%
}}<section end="all_attributes_+%" />

==Transforming attributes==
Converting one attribute to another is called ''transforming''. This can be done on the [[passive skill tree]] by socketing certain unique [[jewels]]. In a large radius, they will transform one attribute - granted by allocated skills in the area - to another attribute.

==Attribute Requirements Mods==
The [[prefix]] {{c|magic|X% reduced Attribute requirements}} has a value of {{c|magic|-18%}} or {{c|magic|-32%}} and lowers the total amount of each attribute needed to wield the specific weapon or armour. The mod can only appear on weapons and armour.

Some [[unique]] [[item]]s have mod {{c|mod| increased/reduced attribute(s) Requirements}}, {{c|mod| +x attribute(s) Requirements}} or {{c|mod| Items and Gems have x% reduced Attribute Requirements}}:
{{Drop enabled unique item table
|tables=item_stats
|join=items._pageID=item_stats._pageID
|where=item_stats.id LIKE "%strength_requirement%" OR item_stats.id LIKE "%intelligence_requirement%" OR item_stats.id LIKE "%dexterity_requirement%" OR item_stats.id LIKE "%attribute_requirement%"
|base_item=1
|large=1
|stat=1
}}

===Cluster Jewel Passives===
The following cluster jewel passives are related to attributes:
{{Passive skill table
|q_where=
  passive_skills.id LIKE "affliction%"
  AND (passive_skills.stat_text LIKE "%attributes%")
|large=1
|stat_text=1
}}

===Tattoos/Runegrafts===
{{Drop enabled item table
|tables = tattoos
|join = items._pageID = tattoos._pageID
|where = items.class_id="StackableCurrency"
  AND tattoos.target IS NOT NULL
  AND items.description LIKE "%attributes%"
|large=1
|description=1
}}
